text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Right here—I make my move!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(My heart—overflows with life—! My 
legs—are filled with strength—!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Where I am running right now is no longer 
an empty void!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Toward a future—with "connections"!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa... This must be...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The true scenery—that I ought to see, 
huh.)

After the race, as I returned to the 
waiting room with Admire Groove—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Good work. It was like... like you were 
dancing across the turf...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
A run that reaches an entirely new 
level... So this is you in the Senior 
Class...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You're getting way too excited, 
honestly.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No, Alv-senpai. Watching you run gave me 
all the conviction I needed."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
You truly are... the Umamusume I should 
study under forever.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see. If that's how it looked, then 
surely...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I suppose that would be for the best. For 
me, as well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“......To think that Alv would... Times 
sure do change.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
("...Such things are nothing but a 
nuisance." Even though that's what I've 
always thought until now.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (......Right now—)

text_block_list.name: Train Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"We will soon be arriving at the final 
stop, Tokyo. Tokyo. Please ensure you do 
not leave any belongings behind as you 
alight--"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "Landing stance"...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ... Yes, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Universe-san. The thing you said you 
wanted to 'observe'..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if my interpretation is 
correct, but—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Together with her—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Walking toward the future—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's still faint, but I think I'm 
starting to see it. What it is that I... 
truly want from the future.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe……"understands." It's 
"CONT"……isn't it?

As I watched Neo Universe leave through 
squinted eyes, our gazes locked dead-on.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...You were awake?
choice_data_list: I'll help. Whatever you wish for.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Please don't... ...Don't smile at me so 
kindly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: So... as for what comes next...

Whether running in the Osaka Hai gave 
Admire Groove a glimpse of what she wished 
for in the future...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
To master my own running. That remains 
unchanged. Yet at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I intend to become a "role model" as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who can inherit and evolve my 
running has appeared by chance. In that 
case—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to... make the most of this 
opportunity.
choice_data_list: I see! I think that's a great idea!
Right! I think that's a great idea!

text_block_list.text:
From solitary pride to coexistence. Admire 
Groove seemed to have made a major shift 
in her way of life.
choice_data_list: So, what's the next target race then?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I am to serve as an example for her, I 
must show her what it means to push to the 
absolute limit.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Given her immense talent, we must do that 
or it won't even serve as a reference. In 
that case, the next step is—
choice_data_list: Aiming for an even higher-level G1... huh.

Aiming for an even higher-level G1... 
right?

text_block_list.text:
After the Osaka Hai, the first leg of the 
Spring Senior Triple Crown... Considering 
her aptitudes, we'll take the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) off the table, and look ahead to—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen... It's the Spring 
Grand Prix, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Talented Umamusume are turning out in 
droves. From the Triple Crown route, the 
Tiara route, and potentially even from the 
Classic class...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. The Takarazuka Kinen... will 
be a great learning experience for 
Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A fresh restart—it is, then. Once we 
return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (A brand-new battle—begins.)

And thus, the train of fate was set to 
speed on, headed straight for the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
